html:
Black September was the war in September 1970 between the army of Jordan and the Palestinian armed groups of the PLO, which had become a state within a state in Jordan after 1967.

Palestinian fighters controlled parts of Amman and set up checkpoints, and some groups called for the overthrow of King Hussein. When one group hijacked several airliners and blew them up on a desert airstrip, the king sent in the army. A Syrian tank force crossed the border to help the Palestinians but turned back.

Thousands were killed. By July 1971 the fighters had been expelled, and they moved to Lebanon, where their presence helped bring on the Lebanese Civil War. A terror group took the name Black September and killed Israeli athletes at the Munich Olympics in 1972.
sum: Black September was the war in September 1970 between the army of Jordan and the Palestinian armed groups of the PLO, which had become a state within a state in Jordan after 1967.
